create_MultinomialRaysampler: create a MultinomialRaysampler to sample rays from a rectangular image grid with configurable depth range
create_NDCMultinomialRaysampler: create an NDCMultinomialRaysampler to sample rays using PyTorch3D normalized device coordinate conventions
create_MonteCarloRaysampler: create a MonteCarloRaysampler to randomly sample rays at real-valued locations in the image plane
run_MultinomialRaysampler_forward: run the MultinomialRaysampler forward pass with cameras to get a RayBundle with origins and directions
run_MonteCarloRaysampler_forward: run the MonteCarloRaysampler forward pass with cameras to sample random rays with stratified depth points
